title: ICC Men's T20 World Cup: Sri Lanka vs Ireland
artist: Sri Lanka and Ireland national teams
description: Sri Lanka's first match at the Premadasa during the 2026 T20 World Cup, co-hosted with India. A Group B night game under the lights.

title: Russell Peters: Relax World Tour Finale
venue: Lumina Ballroom, Cinnamon Life at City of Dreams, Colombo 02
description: One night only. The Canadian comic closed his Relax World Tour in Colombo. Doors opened at 5 pm and tickets started at Rs. 25,000.

title: Aditya Narayan and Sanka Dineth Live
description: The Indian playback singer and the Sri Lankan composer shared one stage to open their Sri Lanka and Japan tour.

title: ONE LOVE Reggae Festival 2026
artist: International reggae headliners, tribute to Bob Marley
description: Billed as South Asia's first three day reggae festival. Moved from March to 7 to 9 August, with an after party at Port City Colombo on the 10th.

title: Ceylon Music Festival 2026
artist: Arash, Mohombi, BNS, Centigradz, Umara, Sarith and Surith
description: Arash and Mohombi headlined, with Bathiya and Santhush, Centigradz, Umara and the Sarith and Surith band on the same bill. Presented by Big Blast Events. Tickets from Rs. 6,000.

title: Senter Music Festival 2026
artist: DJ Snake, DJ MASS and more
description: Two nights on the Port City waterfront, 30 and 31 October. DJ Snake played his first ever Sri Lanka show on the main stage on the Saturday.

title: This Is Michael: Relive the Legend
venue: The Podium, City of Dreams, Colombo 02
description: Milan based tribute artist Lenny Jay recreated Michael Jackson's biggest hits over two nights, 8 and 9 November.

title: Colombo Jazz Under the Stars
artist: The Galle Road Quartet and guests
description: An evening of swing, bossa nova and Sri Lankan jazz standards. Doors open at 6.15 pm, and the bar in the foyer serves before the show and in the interval.

title: Sunset Sessions: Galle Face
description: An open-air afternoon to evening set by the sea, with food stalls along the promenade. Bring a mat. The show goes on in light rain.

title: Lions vs. Visitors: T20 Night Match
description: A day-night T20 under the lights. Gates open 2 hours before the first ball. Outside food and bottles are not allowed in.

title: Laugh Out Loud Colombo
artist: Six stand-up comics, English and Sinhala sets
description: A bilingual stand-up night with new and familiar faces from the Colombo circuit. Suitable for ages 16 and over.

title: Island Beats Beach Festival
description: Two days of electronic, hip hop and baila-fusion acts right on the sand. Day and weekend passes are sold separately, and shuttle buses run from Galle Fort.

title: Rhythms of Lanka: A Dance Showcase
artist: Kandyan, Low Country and Sabaragamuwa troupes
description: The three traditional dance forms of Sri Lanka on one stage, with live drummers. Each piece is introduced in Sinhala, Tamil and English.

title: Neon Nights Live
description: A big-stage concert with a full light show. Standing and seated tickets are available, and seated tickets include a reserved entry lane.

title: Colombo Street Food and Music Fair
description: A family day out with street food from around the island, live bands on the lawn and a kids' corner. Entry is free for children under 12.

title: Inter-School Athletics Finals
description: Track and field finals across the day, with the 4 x 100 m relays as the closing races. The covered stand has free seating.

title: Unplugged at the Lotus
description: A seated, intimate set of original songs and well-loved covers. The perfect end-of-year night out.
